title: Approvals
mineDescription: Show only the approvals you can decide

empty.intro: Approvals are the decisions a person makes before something goes ahead: starting a task a plan flagged, a proposed piece of work, or an escalation where an agent asks a question. Each one is addressed to a person or a role, and only they, or someone more senior, can decide it.
empty.pendingBody: Approvals appear here when a plan, a task or a workflow step needs a person to say yes.
empty.resolvedBody: Decisions show here once they are made.
empty.mine: No pending approval is addressed to you.

select: Select an approval to see what it gates.

escalation.answerHint: Pick an option, or write your own.
escalation.notePlaceholder: Write your answer, or pick an option above
escalation.noteRequired: Pick an option or write an answer first.
escalation.confirmBody: The task stays blocked and the agent gets no answer. A note tells it why.
escalation.explain: Answering releases the blocked task; if an agent is assigned, its run starts with your answer.

issueStart.confirmBody: The task stays in Backlog and whatever waits on it keeps waiting. A note tells whoever asked why.
issueStart.explain: Start moves the task from Backlog to Todo. It does not start a run by itself.

workProposal.confirmBody: The proposed task is cancelled. A note tells the agent who proposed it why.
workProposal.explain: Accepting assigns the task to the owning role's agent and starts a run. Rejecting cancels the proposed task.

default.confirmBody: Whatever this approval gates stays where it is. A note tells the person who asked why.
default.explain: Approving lets what this gates go ahead. Rejecting leaves it where it is.

refusal.adminRequired: An admin has to decide this one.
refusal.notAddressee: This approval is addressed to someone else.
